 No One Wants These Sweet Shelter Puppies Because Of How They Look 
 "They don’t match what someone pictured.”
 By Caitlin Jill Anders Published on Nov 18, 2026 at 3:05 PM Chip and Dale came to Patty Baker Humane Society Naples from a rural shelter in southwest Florida ready to find their forever homes. The two puppies are sweet, social and full of energy. They want to meet every single person who walks by — but unfortunately, because of the way they look, not everyone is as excited to meet them.
 Chip and Dale have a condition called congenital hypotrichosis, which causes patchy fur growth. It isn’t painful and it doesn’t slow them down. It just means they need a little extra care, like sunscreen, shirts, sweaters and regular skin care.
 Normally, puppies get adopted right away, but potential adopters have been put off by the pair’s missing fur, and they haven’t had a single application.
 “We see it pretty often: When a dog looks a little different, people walk past without stopping to meet them,” Becca Morris, CEO of Patty Baker Humane Society Naples, told The Dodo. “Their stays get longer, not because anything is wrong with them, but because they don’t match what someone pictured.”
 For Chip and Dale, they have no idea they’re any different from any other puppies. They just want to play and explore the world, and they’ve quickly become favorites among the shelter staffers.
 “Anyone who spends five minutes with these two forgets about the fur completely,” Morris said.
 Patty Baker Humane Society Naples Chip and Dale are each looking for their own home (so they’re more able to bond with their families rather than each other) where they can continue to grow and learn. They’ll need a little help caring for their skin, but otherwise they need the same things as any other puppy: love and attention.
 Patty Baker Humane Society Naples “Each of them deserves a family of their own, and we’d love for that to happen soon,” Morris said.
 If you’re interested in adopting Chip or Dale , you can contact Patty Baker Humane Society Naples for more information. Related Related No One Wanted These Pit Bull Puppies — So The Shelter Gave Them Cowboy Hats
